evidence: Carries the Tests label and fixes intermittent test flakiness in interface_bitcoin_cli.py caused by wall-clock timing jitter under CI load.
rationale: Fixes an intermittent test failure in CI where a strict wall-clock assertion fails by tens of milliseconds under heavy Docker load. The author notes that 'Under Docker CI load the process can return a few tens of milliseconds early, failing assert_greater_than_or_equal(time.time(), start_time + 5) (~40ms observed).' While resolving flaky tests protects CI signal, this is a minor timing adjustment for an infrequent CI race.
